page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highcpu-2 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.
This server configuration does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on an arm64 architecture, the c4a-highcpu-2 offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads that benefit from dedicated compute resources without requiring large memory footprints. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for compute-bound tasks such as lightweight web serving, containerized microservices, and basic CI/CD pipeline tasks optimized for ARM processors.
